Tuscolano Sud — Rome, Italy

🟡 Local press research

Average day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Tuscolano Sud takes in the Cinecittà area, a mixed residential and commercial district near the famous film studios. Press coverage is extensive and troubling: the occupied former Hotel Cinecittà has been described as a mini favela run by criminal gangs charging illegal rents, with reported stabbings, threats and extortion among occupants before a police-led eviction; press characterised the broader Cinecittà-Don Bosco corridor as a ticking time bomb of drug dealing, illegal occupations and street clashes; and shopkeepers in Cinecittà Est have described intimidation linked to the Casamonica clan. Given multiple, separately documented and recurring serious incidents, red at night is warranted; daytime commercial and residential activity continues largely as normal, so yellow.
